name: Escape Rain For Lucky Blocks
desc:
🌧️ Welcome to Escape Rain for Lucky Blocks! 🌧️

Run across fun areas, dodge the rain, and survive until the storm ends!😱

🏃 Escape the dangerous rain!
☔ Take cover under shelters!
🏠 Collect Lucky Blocks and bring them back to your Base!
💵 Earn Cash and grow stronger!

👍 Don’t forget to Like & Favorite!
